title: Concerto
identity: William Schmidt's Concerto for alto saxophone is published by Western International Music as AV257, with a piano reduction edited by Sharon Davis and solo part. An archived University of Arkansas saxophone recital lists a complete performance by Will Brani with pianist S. Michael Shuman on April 25, 2015.

evidence.claim: University archive identifies saxophone/piano performers, date, and Concerto by William Schmidt in recital contents.
Retailer identifies WIM AV257 and piano reduction edited by Sharon Davis; marked permanently out of print.

review_focus: Inference: concerto format plus a full recital performance provide a concrete college-programming precedent; inspect score for actual solo and accompaniment demands.
collection_flag: Performed on a university senior recital; accompaniment setting may be piano reduction rather than orchestra.
gaps: Recital audio was not downloaded or auditioned; no score notation inspected; duration and orchestration remain unresolved.
